text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The conclusions of a parliamentary commission looking into alleged ties between the state and underworld demand an enquiry into allegations against Foreign Minister Tansu Ciller and that the immunity from prosecution of two government MPs be lifted.
- Turks are cheered up by the Turkish national soccer team victory against the Netherlands.
- Turkish writer Adalet Agaoglu wims the Aydin Dogan novel award for her work "A Romantic Viennese Summer".
- Istanbul police seize 20 bottles of poisonous gas before it is sold to the rebel Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK).
- The Audit court approves the Istanbul underground train system tender.
- Three MPs are expelled from a leftist opposition party and another five a warned by a party disciplinary board.
- The constitutional court annuls some articles of the build-operate-transfer (BOT) law.
- The private sector debates investment possibilities in infrastructure and energy.
